title: Chat Audience Check
summary: Before a sensitive message goes to a group chat, flags members who don't seem to belong, so it doesn't reach the wrong person.
description: Flags members whose name differs from how you saved them, unidentifiable names, people who joined after your last message and outsiders. Quiet for ordinary messages; for sensitive text it lists them with Remove, View profile and "I know them" and needs a second press.
catches: Members whose display name disagrees with what you saved them as
People who joined after your last message
People outside your organisation, or marked external by the platform
Messages with sensitive terms, which raise the check
limits: Only as good as the member, contact and organisation data you pass
Sensitive-term matching is a word list (replaceable)
Sending is still possible after a second press
a11y: Visible <label>; the textarea is described by the flagged-member list
Escape cancels the second-press state; Enter sends only when not composing (IME-safe)
Focus moves to the first action in the flagged list
Remove buttons set aria-busy; errors use role="alert" and status a role="status" region
server: Membership and access to the conversation must be enforced by the chat service; this is a pre-send review.
stops: Secret message reached a stranger in group
